'''Kam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A [[Jedi Consular]] and combat instructor, Kam frequented the [[Senate Commercial District]] beneath the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
